preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of elements in array a is between 2 and 10^6.
The number of elements in set B is between 1 and n/2.
Each element in array a is between -10^9 and 10^9.
Each element in set B is between 1 and n/2.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer representing the maximum possible sum of all a_i after applying the operation any number of times.

invariants.expression: sum(n) over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
invariants.description: The sum of the number of elements in array a over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.
